versions.changelog:
- Added detailed SKILL.md instructions for applying and customizing the WorkBuddy desktop app skin using command-line tools.
- Describes apply/pause workflow, how to modify theme and DOM structure, and scope/limitations of the skin injection process.
- Emphasizes a no-step-by-step user interaction approach; all actions handled via CLI commands.
- Clarifies non-intrusive design: does not modify system app files, injection resets on full app restart.
